description: A single account inside an expandable Assets/Debts section on the Finances (goals tab) screen. Tokenized replacement for the inline AccountRow. Icon chip + name/subtitle + optional real-data sparkline + balance, tappable to a detail route.

iconToken.description: Semantic token key: property=primary, cash=info, investments=success, debt=error

trendData.description: REAL history only; omit if none (no synthetic arrays)

reuses: components/Sparkline.tsx (small, filled off, only when trendData is real)

accessibility.label: {name}, {subtitle}, {balance}. Double tap to open.
accessibility.note: balance flexShrink 0 — never truncates; name/subtitle ellipsize.

developerNotes: Drop the current `bal * 0.9 … bal` synthetic trend arrays — pass real history or omit the sparkline.
